qa_pairs.question: How has the duty-free baggage allowance for Bangladeshi crew members working on airlines changed according to the most recent customs regulations compared to the 2012 policy?
qa_pairs.answer: Under the 2012 regulations [0], the duty-free baggage allowance for airline crew was 100 USD. According to the most recent regulation from 2025 [4], this allowance has been adjusted to 150 USD.

qa_pairs.question: What is the current duty-free allowance for baggage imported by Bangladeshi airline crew members upon returning from professional duty, and how does it compare to the allowance set in 2024?
qa_pairs.answer: As of the 2025 regulation [4], the duty-free allowance for baggage for airline crew members is 150 USD. This is a decrease from the 300 USD allowance that was in effect under the 2024 regulation [3].
